covered_units: Llei 15/2025, article 22: scope of online publications; hosting location and domain; access unrestricted or restricted
Llei 15/2025, article 8.3: publisher duties for online deposit and the National Library's selection role
Llei 15/2025, article 25: no legal-deposit number for online publications; separate ISBN/standard identifier obligation when applicable
Llei 15/2025, article 11: three copies per book as the general rule; one for bibliographic materials with print runs under 30.
Llei 15/2025, article 23: private correspondence, intranet, personal data files, and legal-rights exclusions for online deposit.
Llei 15/2025, articles 9 and 11: request the deposit number before finishing production; deliver copies after completion and before publication.
Llei 15/2025, articles 3.5 and 15: preservation of radio productions by the National Archive; two copies per fixed-periodicity broadcast despite a single deposit number.
Llei 15/2025, article 29: on-site consultation of digital deposits through a closed internal network; copyright and other legitimate interests remain protected.
Decret 100/2026, article 6: web crawling for freely accessible online publications; site-holder cooperation; Library selection and capture frequency.
Decret 100/2026, article 7: restricted-access and subscription websites; requested credentials; keeping access information current and access permanent.
Llei 15/2025, articles 30-31: late delivery is a minor offense; fines; repeat offenses; paying a fine does not remove the deposit obligation.
Llei 15/2025, article 22: Andorran editor/resident and .ad domain as independent inclusion criteria.
